title: Canonical coefficient restriction comparison types
statement: For finite commutative rings A,B,C and a scheme W, use the canonical constant-coefficient derived categories D(W_proet,A). Derived scalar restriction, its specified identity and composition comparisons with prescribed ring-map equality casts, and the fixed-compactification coefficient comparison have the displayed source and target categories. Their values are exactly the existing constructions of [lem-sf-compact-support-restriction-of-scalars, lem-sf-open-extension-scalar-restriction-coherence]. No map, object, coefficient action or comparison normalization is changed.

def compactSupportCoefficientResComp (W : Scheme.{u})
    (φ : A →+* B) (ψ : B →+* C) (χ : A →+* C) (hχ : ψ.comp φ = χ) :
    compactSupportCoefficientRestriction W ψ ⋙
        compactSupportCoefficientRestriction W φ ≅
      compactSupportCoefficientRestriction W χ
